label: chromium__model-picker-popover-open-non-first-selected
description: KNOWN a11y limitation, not fixable in app code (LE-2235). The two <span tabindex="0" data-radix-focus-guard> elements are injected at the <body> edges by Radix's FocusScope (via react-remove-scroll / focus-guards) while the model-picker Popover is open, so IBM reports element_tabbable_role_valid on them. They are opacity:0, pointer-events:none, 1px focus sentinels that keep Tab inside the modal-like popover; they carry no content and are never announced. Radix does not expose a way to add a role or remove them, and they disappear as soon as the popover closes. Only these two guards are baselined — every other violation on this scan state is tracked separately (label_ref_valid: backlog item 09 / #14517; canvas node role: LE-1514 F3; rf__background svg: LE-2210). Delete this file to resurface the guards in tests/a11y/model-picker-canvas.a11y.spec.ts.
